title: Extreme Optimization
description: This project adds a lot of optimizations to Minecraft, boosts my frame rate from <20fps to a stable 75fps (due to v-sync) and adds a lot of utilities, sacrificing some visuals. 此项目为Minecraft增加大量优化，将我的帧率从<20fps提升到稳定75fps(由于垂直同步)，并增加许多实用工具，美中不足的是牺牲了一些视觉效果。

- ImmediatelyFast may cause problems such as startup failures, wrong or missing item textures, incorrect solid rendering, etc. on some devices.【ImmediatelyFast在某些设备上可能会导致启动失败、物品纹理错误或缺失、实体渲染不正确等问题】
  
- Better Block Entities (BBE) may cause rendering glitches with blocks like beds, chests, pots, bells, and shulker boxes. 【更好的方块实体（BBE）可能会导致床、箱子、陶罐、铃铛和潜影盒等方块的渲染故障。】

### 特色
- 作者尽力减少了前置库的数量并尽量使一个前置库作用于多个模组，毕竟减少模组数量也有利于性能提升
- 使用Sodium，ImmediatelyFast等30多个性能优化模组（无论大众小众）
- 完工后，作者的Minecraft帧率从10~20提升到75（作者开了垂直同步）
- 在模组配置中牺牲大量视觉效果（有正面也有负面）以减轻渲染负担
- 添加大量实用性工具，包括但不限于自动疾跑，自动钓鱼，自由相机（即灵魂出窍），方块表面亮度提示，以及一大批细节改进如爬梯子时向上看会自动向上爬而不用按住（有的可能不公平）
- 如果可以，点个收藏或者赞助吧，作者花费了数十个小时挑选模组和调整配置，几乎开箱即用


### 按键绑定
- Q：自由相机（在一次不慎丢失附魔钻石剑后）
- B：对调主手副手物品
- 其他原版按键：懒得讲了
- M：开关副手物品渲染
- C：缩放
- X：开关小地图
- F：放大小地图（大小）
- V：放大小地图（推近）
- G：打开世界地图
- K：开关全亮度
- Z：Free look（按住）
- R：整理容器（只有打开容器GUI且鼠标指向时）
- J+Number：记录自由相机位置
- N：切换自由相机中相机移动or玩家移动
- F9：在所有完整方块上显示出亮度级别
- 有tooltip的时候，上下左右方向键可以移动tooltip


### 问题
- 为什么没有Cloth Config API? 因为我的模组列表当中有一个使用了Jar-in-Jar自带了，无需额外安装，以求简洁
- 为什么贴图看上去分辨率很低？ 因为我自制了一个8x8资源包，不喜欢可以删掉这个资源包
- 删除资源包后还是感觉分辨率低？ 在模组菜单中找到Render Scale打开配置界面，将渲染精细度调至1.0（如果你的设备性能不错，可以调得更高）
- 钓鱼时自动收竿了？ 哈哈，Auto Fish正在发挥作用
- 为什么不绑定疾跑的按键？ 因为我使用Sprint By Default
- 一些声音无法开启？ 在模组菜单，Audio Engine Tweaks的设置中调整
- 箱子、钟、陶罐、床、告示牌等渲染错误？ 看看是不是BBE在作怪
- 黑暗、水、雾气、屏幕扭曲、火焰都去哪里了？在ClearViews和Sodium Extra中看看
- 实体突然消失？ 没准是因为Opticores
- UI卡卡的？讨厌的话就删掉Exordium
- 没有发光效果？不习惯就删No Glow
- 某些服务器进不去？尝试在多人游戏列表的右下角关闭No Chat Reports
- 烦人的通知变少了？Stfu和Sodium Extra的功劳
- 为什么这个整合包只给了1.21.10版本？你可以使用ViaFabricPlus加入其他版本的服务器，作者已经很累以至于不想再做其他版本
- 死亡后聊天栏中出现数字？WDID会告诉你你失败的位置
- 没有夜视效果？我用Better Night Vision禁用了，因为CameraTweaks给了我全亮


### 注意
- 如果你自行更新、删除或添加模组导致了崩溃、卡顿等问题，我概不负责。建议使用原版整合包以确保稳定性。除非原版整合包出问题，否则不要反馈给我
- 建议使用Java 25搭配分代ZGC以获得更好的内存调度
- 如果你的输入法在游戏中不会出错，那么可以删除IMBlocker（中国玩家不建议删）
- 中国人不建议删除名为“Xaero地图汉化”的资源包
- 作者没有经过很多测试，如果原版资源包出了问题，私信作者
- 如果有建议，作者乐意采纳，欢迎联系作者（xzh13559588685@yeah.net）
- 由于这个整合包是作者结合自己的设备制作的，其中的一些优化可能并不适合你的设备
- 作者使用的设备：机带RAM 8GB（可用7.8GB），3GHz的Intel(R) Pentium(R) CPU G3220，113MB的Intel(R) HD Graphics显卡。（真的很老了，如果你愿意赞助，作者将万分感谢；若不行，一个收藏也足够了qwq）

### **Features**
- I've tried to minimize the number of pre-libraries and try to apply one pre-library to multiple modules, since reducing the number of modules also helps improve performance
- Uses over 30 performance mods like Sodium and ImmediatelyFast (both popular and niche).
- After optimization, the author's FPS increased from 10-20 to 75 (with vertical sync enabled).
- Sacrifices visual effects in mod configurations (whether good or bad) to reduce rendering load.
- Adds many useful tools, including auto-sprint, auto-fishing, free camera (soul detachment), block brightness overlay, and QoL improvements like auto-climbing ladders when looking up (some may be unfair).
- Consider starring or donating if you like it! The author spent dozens of hours selecting mods and tuning settings for near plug-and-play experience.


### **Key Bindings**
- **Q**: Free camera (added after losing a diamond sword in frustration).
- **B**: Swap main/off-hand items.
- **Other vanilla keys**: Self-explanatory.
- **M**: Toggle off-hand item rendering.
- **C**: Zoom.
- **X**: Toggle minimap.
- **F**: Resize minimap (scale).
- **V**: Zoom minimap (pan).
- **G**: Open world map.
- **K**: Toggle full brightness.
- **Z**: Free look (hold).
- **R**: Sort inventory (only when the container GUI is open and the mouse is hovering over it).
- **J+Number**: Save free camera position.
- **N**: Switch between camera/player control in free camera mode.
- **F9**: Show light levels on all solid blocks.
- **Arrow keys**: Move tooltips when active.


### **FAQ**
- **No Cloth Config API?** One mod bundles it via Jar-in-Jar packaging.
- **Low-resolution textures?** The author made an 8x8 resource pack. Delete it if you dislike it.
- **Persistent low resolution after removing the resource pack?** Adjust Render Scale in the mod menu to 1.0 (higher if your hardware allows).
- **Auto-reeling during fishing?** Auto Fish is working.
- **No sprint key?** Using Sprint By Default.
- **Missing sounds?** Adjust Audio Engine Tweaks settings.
- **Render glitches with chests/clocks/blocks?** Check BBE settings.
- **No darkness/water/fog/flames?** Adjust ClearViews and Sodium Extra.
- **Disappearing entities?** Likely due to Optcores.
- **Laggy UI?** Remove Exordium.
- **No glow effects?** Remove No Glow.
- **Server connection issues?** Disable No Chat Reports in multiplayer settings.
- **Fewer notifications?** Thanks to Stfu and Sodium Extra.
- **Only 1.21.10 version?** Use ViaFabricPlus to join other versions. The author is too tired to support more.
- **Numbers in chat after death?** WDID shows your death coordinates.
- **No night vision?** Better Night Vision disabled it; CameraTweaks provides full brightness.


### **Notes**
- I assume no responsibility for crashes, lag, or other issues caused by users updating, removing, or adding mods themselves. It is recommended to use the original modpack to ensure stability. Unless there is a problem with the original modpack, do not report it to me.
- Use **Java 25, Generational ZGC** to achieve better performance.
- **Delete IMBlocker** if your Input Method works fine.（If you are Chinese, I do not advise you to delete it.）
- If you are not Chinese, I suggest that you can delete the Resourse Pack named "Xaero地图汉化".
- Report issues to the author via xzh13559588685@yeah.net
- Suggestions welcome!
